name: ossify
description: Skeleton-first lifecycle from Release 0 through MVP and v1. A replacement for scaffold-onboard + scaffold-dev, not a stage alongside them. Requires workspace-init: /ossify:start refuses without its pairing manifest. Self-sufficient: the grill and critic ship in-tree as /ossify:challenge (configurable adversary). /ossify:start onboards a new project, /ossify:adopt an existing codebase, /ossify:plan-release and /ossify:plan-spine plan the work, /ossify:run-spine drives the rounds, /ossify:close runs the ceremony, /ossify:doctor diagnoses, plus the any-repo /ossify:handoff and /ossify:work-pr.
